items: Launched in August 1998, based on the R.V. Gupta Committee recommendations.
o Managed by NABARD and RBI.
o Aims to provide low-interest loans for agricultural needs and promote institutional lending.
o Loan amount: Up to Rs. 3 lakh at 7% interest with 3% interest subvention for timely
o Validity: The card is valid for 5 years.
o Loans can be used for agriculture, animal husbandry, and fisheries.
o Eligibility: Farmers and those involved in allied activities like dairy, poultry, etc.
